title: E4 snap radius: world-px constant compared in screen px without Scale conversion
detail: kSnapRadius is defined and documented as world px (E4), but the distance compare runs in screen px without multiplying by Fit.Scale. Effective world radius = 36/Scale: ~39 px at 1280x720, ~26 px at the observed 1896x1081 DPI geometry — viewport-dependent snap tolerance violating the documented contract.
recommended_fix: In SnapToNode use RadiusPx = static_cast<float>(PP::kSnapRadius) * Fit.Scale so the inclusive radius is honored in world px at every viewport scale.

title: FPPSimDriver::Advance spins forever if PP::Step declines to advance State.Tick (bTerminal early return)
detail: Step documents early-returns that leave State.Tick unchanged; the driver loop only exits when Tick reaches TargetTick. bTerminal is a never-set placeholder today, but story 1.4's win/lose will make it reachable → unbounded game-thread spin, editor hang.
recommended_fix: Break the loop when a Step call fails to advance State.Tick (e.g. capture prev tick per iteration), or check State.bTerminal before stepping in Advance.

title: flow_summary.spawned computed by two different formulas in the two golden writers
evidence:
PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:137:
			ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score,
tests/spine_check.cpp:641:
			static_cast<int>(State.Flow.Packets.size()) + State.Score, // spawned = delivered + live
docs/goldens/SCHEMA.md:45:
| `flow_summary.spawned` | int | demand entries fired (packets constructed) |
detail: The probe reports seeded demand (Demand.size()); spine-check reports delivered+live. They coincide only at the pinned seed=42/ticks=100 run (11==11), so gate 7 passes — exactly the cross-writer drift SCHEMA.md single-sourcing exists to prevent; any ticks<98 run or future packet loss diverges them.
recommended_fix: Single-source the formula: count actual spawns once (e.g. a fired/spawned counter in FFlowState, or NextPacketId delta) and use it in both writers; document it in SCHEMA.md.

title: DragStartGrid/EndGrid computed but never read; bHasLastEditError written but never consumed
detail: Dead state from the r1 grid-snap design: the E4 snap is now fully screen-space, so the grid conversions are unused. The header comment claims 'for the status line (rejection feedback)' but the status line renders only tick/packets/score.
recommended_fix: Delete DragStartGrid, the EndGrid local, and bHasLastEditError, or wire LastEditError into StatusText to deliver the promised rejection feedback.

title: EndDraw's 'appears THIS frame' immediate BuildSnapshot is invisible to the widget — change detection is Tick-keyed
detail: An edit changes TopologyGen, never Tick; the view refreshes its cached pair only inside the Tick-change branch, so the immediate BuildSnapshot cannot surface the pipe this frame — it lands at the next sim step (≤50 ms at 20 Hz). The two comments contradict each other; story 1.2 says 'same frame'.
recommended_fix: Also compare TopologyGen in NativeTick's change detection (rebuild on gen change without waiting for Tick), or correct the comment to state the next-step refresh.
